name: Gateway of India
short_description: Mumbai's iconic waterfront monument overlooking the Arabian Sea.
description: The Gateway of India is one of Mumbai's most recognizable landmarks and a popular starting point for exploring the city's historic waterfront.

name: Taj Mahal
short_description: The iconic white-marble monument of Agra.
description: The Taj Mahal is one of India's most famous landmarks and a major destination for travelers visiting Agra.

name: City Palace
short_description: A historic royal palace complex in the heart of Jaipur.
description: The City Palace is a major Jaipur attraction showcasing Rajput and Mughal architectural influences.

name: Lake Pichola
short_description: A scenic artificial lake surrounded by Udaipur's historic landscape.
description: Lake Pichola is one of Udaipur's signature attractions, known for its scenic views, islands and historic palaces.

name: Goa Beaches
short_description: Beautiful beaches and coastal experiences around Goa.
description: Goa is known for its beaches, coastal scenery, relaxed atmosphere and vibrant tourism experiences.
